annotations.title: Fill the user’s answers into a job’s application form

description: Use this when the user has answered the open questions of a job’s application form (Bewerbung) from get_job_matches or list_saved_jobs or left them to you: all answers at once, by `kennung` (a text, one of its `auswahlwerte`, a list if `mehrfach`). Stores them and fills the form in the app or browser extension, now or once opened. `nur_pro` fields are refused. `abgelegt.offen` lists empty required fields: decide the `offen` ones left, then give `link`. Submits nothing. Scope: bewerbung:senden.
name: set_form_fields
title: Fill the user’s answers into a job’s application form
